sahneler.metin: A German chemical plant exploded, leaving a huge crater.
The town of Oppau was flattened, and hundreds were killed.
Workers had been breaking up caked fertilizer with dynamite.
They had done it thousands of times safely.
It contained more ammonium nitrate than before.
This time, the blast set off the whole pile.
Blasting fertilizer stockpiles was stopped after the disaster.

aciklama:
Oppau exploded, leaving a huge crater. The cause: detonation of an ammonium sulfate-nitrate mixture richer in nitrate than believed safe.

#shorts #engineering #industrial

vaka.tetik: dynamite used to break up caked fertilizer
vaka.mekanizma: detonation of an ammonium sulfate-nitrate mixture richer in nitrate than believed safe

vaka.yanilgi: Blasting had been done thousands of times without incident. A change in the mixture made it explosive.
vaka.tartisma: A method that worked thousands of times failed once. How do you notice when conditions quietly change?
